title: Every money trap the middle class falls into, explained
description:
Why does a raise never seem to change your bank balance?
Rohan earns more every year and still runs in place. This video follows him through six money traps that never feel like mistakes: the life that grows with every raise, the new car, the safe cash, the small charges that never stop, the bigger house and the one that costs the most of all.
Count how many you are in.
